author: rdc-rfc1-author-b (Claude Haiku 5.5)
rationale: periph_rst_no ANDs a clk_core-synchronised reset with link_up_q from the asynchronous clk_link domain. The exported reset therefore asserts and releases at clk_link edges and can glitch when the two inputs change together.

author_reading.rationale: periph_rst_no is a combinational AND of a clk_core-synchronised reset and a flag flop clocked by the unrelated clk_link; the flag can toggle while the synchronised reset is high, so the output reset can glitch and assert the peripheral reset spuriously.

labels.rationale: periph_rst_no is a reset-named net that combines a synchronised core reset with link_up_q, a clk_link register. Its value changes at clk_link edges, unsynchronised to clk_core, so the peripheral reset can glitch or release unsafely.

Link status can release the peripheral output at any phase of clk_core. If link_up_q falls just after the core stage rises, the output can produce a short release pulse, and core_active_o samples the same asynchronous result.
labels.suspected_flaw: There is no local peripheral reset pin, so the reset-net rules cannot identify the exported pulse directly.

settlement.detection_gap: The gated reset periph_rst_no is only exported. No local asynchronous reset pin reads it, so the reset-net rules (RDC-007/008/009/017), which start from local reset roots, do not see it. CST-012 (multi-domain output) is outside the RDC deck and does not address the glitch.
settlement.rationale: Both readers are right on bad, critical and class. B's flaw is decisive for the rules: periph_rst_no drives no local reset pin, so none of A's RDC-009/RDC-017 triggers fire. B's CDC rules concern core_active_o sampling, not the reset, and are outside the RDC deck. The settler records a detection gap and uses A's sites.

was.detection_gap: The gated reset periph_rst_no is only exported. No local asynchronous reset pin reads it, so the reset-net rules (RDC-007/008/009/017), which start from local reset roots, do not see it. CST-012 (multi-domain output) is outside the RDC deck and does not address the glitch.

adjudication.reason: RDC-009 reports a top-level output that builds a reset from a reset root and a functional leaf (exported reset, consumer outside the design); the frozen detection gap no longer holds
